# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented here. The project follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.1.0] - 2026-08-07

### Added

- Typed Four Pillars and Day Master calculation.
- IANA historical time-zone, DST, and true-solar-time handling.
- Midnight and Zi-hour day-boundary policies.
- Hidden stems and Ten God helpers.
- Versioned Five Element distribution and support analysis.
- Precise Sect 2 Da Yun starting offsets and cycles.
- Deterministic cross-chart relationship analysis.
- Unknown-time uncertainty reporting.
- English and Simplified Chinese documentation.
- CI, coverage thresholds, issue templates, security policy, and contribution guidelines.
